text:
The classic Hakone mistake: doing the whole cable car, ropeway and boat loop, then doing it all again to get back. From Moto-Hakone, the H-line bus takes you down to Hakone-Yumoto in about 30 minutes 👇

🧭 One small change to your Hakone day, and you get an extra hour 👉 https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

❌ THE MISTAKE

Most first-timers treat the loop as the only way around Hakone. It's beautiful one way. The second time, it's mostly queues and changes.

✅ THE FIX

Ride the ropeway out, when your legs and your camera are fresh: about 30 minutes over Owakudani's steam vents, gondolas roughly every minute. Cross the lake by boat to Moto-Hakone. Then take the bus home: about 30 minutes to Hakone-Yumoto for ¥1,210, or back up towards Gora via Kowakien.

⏰ WATCH THE CLOCK

The ropeway runs until 16:45, and until 16:15 in December and January. Go out in the morning, not after lunch.

🌬️ AND ON A WINDY DAY

The ropeway and boats can stop in strong wind. Check Hakone Navi's live status before you leave Tokyo; if they're down, the bus does the whole trip, and Freepass holders get the unused part refunded at their last station.

👉 Where to eat at each end, and the bus that saves you the loop:
https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

Have you done the loop both ways before? Save this for next time 📌
